description: This Java source file implements the PaymentModule interface to handle BeanStream payment transactions within a Spring-based e-commerce system. It provides methods for initiating, authorizing, capturing, and refunding payments through communication with BeanStream's API, constructing request messages, sending HTTP POST requests, and parsing the responses to generate Transaction objects.

classes.name: BeanStreamPayment
classes.description: Implements the PaymentModule interface for handling BeanStream payment transactions including authorization, capture, refund, and validation of module configuration.

methods.name: initTransaction
methods.description: Initializes a payment transaction (not implemented, returns null).

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Performs payment authorization by processing a transaction of type AUTHORIZE.

methods.name: capture
methods.description: Captures a pre-authorized transaction by sending a PAC request to BeanStream.

methods.name: authorizeAndCapture
methods.description: Performs an authorization and capture in one step.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Processes a refund or void transaction with BeanStream.

methods.name: sendTransaction
methods.description: Sends an HTTP POST request to BeanStream's API to perform different transaction types (purchase, refund, capture).

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses the response from BeanStream into a Transaction object.

methods.name: formatUrlResponse
methods.description: Converts the URL-encoded response payload into a key-value map.

methods.name: validateModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if the necessary configuration keys (merchant id, username, password) are set.
